title: Lovely Earthy Venezuelan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A delicious and energizing Venezuelan dish featuring shredded monterey jack cheese and bonito flakes, perfect for a snack or lunch. This earthy and creamy dish is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese and bonito flakes.
Place one tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle half of the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is lightly browned and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make a second quesadilla.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with chopped cilantro on top if desired.
